sql.value: select k.id, k.user_id, u.username as user_name, k.name, k.description, k.key_prefix, k.allowed_model_ids, k.allowed_ip_list, k.rpm_limit, k.tpm_limit, k.monthly_token_quota, k.tokens_used_this_month, k.quota_reset_time, k.expire_time, k.last_used_time, k.enable_status, k.sort, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time from ai_api_key k left join sys_user u on u.id = k.user_id where k.is_deleted = 0 #[and k.name like concat('%', :name, '%')] #[and k.user_id = :userId] #[and k.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by k.sort desc, k.id desc

select k.id, k.user_id, k.name, k.description, k.key_hash, k.key_prefix, k.allowed_model_ids, k.allowed_ip_list, k.rpm_limit, k.tpm_limit, k.monthly_token_quota, k.tokens_used_this_month, k.quota_reset_time, k.expire_time, k.last_used_time, k.enable_status, k.sort, k.is_deleted, k.revision from ai_api_key k where k.is_deleted = 0 and k.key_hash = :keyHash

select id, api_key_id, user_id, stat_date, request_count, success_count, blocked_count, error_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost, create_time, update_time from ai_api_key_usage_daily where api_key_id = :apiKeyId and stat_date = :statDate

select api_key_id, user_id, stat_date, request_count, success_count, blocked_count, error_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost from ai_api_key_usage_daily where api_key_id = :apiKeyId and stat_date >= :startDate order by stat_date asc
